title: Vauld begins operating
description: Vauld developed as a crypto lending and yield platform serving retail users with deposit and lending products.

title: Vauld halts withdrawals, trading, and deposits
description: Vauld suspended customer withdrawals, trading, and deposits during the 2022 credit crisis.

title: Vauld seeks creditor protection
description: Vauld sought protection and restructuring time after the platform halt.

title: Nexo transaction talks announced
description: Vauld announced exploratory acquisition or transaction discussions with Nexo after the platform halt.
notes: Later transaction outcome needs direct source upgrade.

title: Vauld restructuring process continues
description: Vauld remained in a creditor and restructuring process after proposed transaction paths did not quickly restore normal platform operations.
notes: Placeholder seed event requiring direct creditor update sources.

title: Haru Invest begins operating
description: Haru Invest operated as a crypto deposit and yield service with multiple yield products.

title: Haru Invest suspends deposits and withdrawals
description: Haru Invest suspended deposits and withdrawals after reporting an issue with a service partner.

title: Haru-related operations remain halted
description: Haru services did not return to normal operations after the withdrawal suspension.

title: Haru Invest legal proceedings intensify
description: Haru became the subject of legal proceedings related to customer deposits and alleged platform conduct.
notes: Use conservative wording until direct court sources are added.

title: Customer recovery remains unresolved
description: Customer recovery remained unresolved while the legal and claims process continued.

title: Seoul Bankruptcy Court declares Haru Management Limited bankrupt
description: The Seoul Bankruptcy Court declared Haru Management Limited bankrupt after finding grounds of inability to pay. Contemporary court reporting identifies Haru Management Limited as the Haru Invest operating entity responsible for membership, product subscriptions, and management of customer virtual assets.
notes: This event establishes bankruptcy of the operating entity and commencement of a court-supervised creditor process. It does not establish a completed customer distribution or resolve criminal allegations against Haru executives.

title: CoinLoan begins operating
description: CoinLoan developed as a custodial crypto lending and interest-account platform.

title: CoinLoan restricts withdrawals as court restrains asset disposal
description: CoinLoan reduced customer withdrawal access and an Estonian court prohibited CoinLoan OÜ from disposing of assets without the provisional trustee's consent.
notes: The event combines the customer-facing withdrawal restriction with the same-day official provisional asset restraint.

title: Harju County Court declares CoinLoan OÜ bankrupt
description: The Harju County Court declared CoinLoan OÜ bankrupt at 10:00 on 14 June 2023 in civil proceeding 2-23-3290.
notes: The official Estonian notice provides the exact declaration date and proceeding number.

title: CoinLoan ceases normal platform operations
description: Following the bankruptcy declaration, CoinLoan no longer operated as a normal lending and interest-account platform.
notes: The bankruptcy date is used as the effective end of ordinary platform operations.

title: Court confirms CoinLoan creditor list
description: The court confirmed the creditor list submitted by the CoinLoan bankruptcy trustee in proceeding 2-23-3290.
notes: Creditor-list confirmation advanced the claims process but did not establish final recovery for every creditor class.
